Topics covered in this PDF

BRL-101 (Overview of Retailing) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Challenges of Indian retailers, technology adoption, retail consumer behaviour, sourcing and supplier identification
  • Financial management in retailing, GST, technology in retailing, rural markets, cash and carry, business ethics

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: Tutor Marked Assignment (TMA), course title Overview of Retailing, coverage all blocks, maximum marks 100, attempt all questions. Part A: seven short type questions (10 each, Q4 is 5+5). Part B: two essay type questions (Q8 is 15, Q9 is 8+7)

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
